scenarios.title: Load, burst, slow dependencies, stale projection

branches.note: 600 s at 200 reads/s and 50 commands/s on the local single-host fixture (final report .local/load/20261118T002830Z): read p95 18.2 ms, command p95 46.9 ms, 0 errors; Core transfers 958/s p95 20.1 ms. See docs/implementation/local-qualification.md.

branches.reason: CF-04: in WP-30 the 5-minute 3x burst timed out 21,769 of 22,501 payment intents (504). WP-41 removed the duplicate validation pass in intent creation. With the WP-30 parameters (600 s sustained, 300 s burst; report .local/load/20261119T204944Z) every request returned successfully: 22,500 of 22,500 intents returned 201, intent p95 4.05 s, max 4.96 s; the before run on the same host had 21,970 timeouts (.local/load/20261119T201637Z). The branch stays FAIL because the single host could not deliver the full 3x schedule: the burst phase took 349 s to issue 300 s of requests, so every kind ran at 86% of 3x (about 2.6x), and burst p50 latencies show queueing. Demonstrating 3x needs a separate load generator or the production topology (DEC-07). The host also ran an unrelated k3s server during both measurements.

The measured run was 600 s sustained plus 300 s burst; the one-hour NFR-05 duration was not executed (make test-load-measured with --sustained 3600). Production capacity needs the chosen deployment (DEC-07).

branches.note: WP-41: one measured change (create_intent no longer re-validates the quote it just validated; one Core authority read serves the Controls decision and the delegate limit). Same host, same parameters: sustained intent p95 65.9 to 38.3 ms; burst intents 61.1/s with 21,970 timeouts to 67.9/s with 0 (60 s plus 300 s runs). Confirmation still re-validates everything before any reservation or posting; the full regression passed.
